production.note: US model years. Infiniti USA's G35 page heads its specification column "G35 Sedan (2007-2008)" (VQ35HR, 306 hp) and says the G35 was "Offered as a coupe from 2003–2007 and a sedan from 2003–2008" and "Production of the INFINITI G35 ended in 2008, when it was replaced by the INFINITI G37." The earlier V35 sedan (2003-2006) and the V35 coupe are not covered by this record; neither is the AWD G35x.

body.note: The 306 hp VQ35HR car is the 2007-2008 G35 Sedan in Infiniti's table. The Car and Driver panel has no Vehicle Type line; its dimensions ("Height: 57.2 in", "Passenger Volume: 96 ft3") fit the sedan.

configuration.note: VQ35HR. Panel: "DOHC 24-valve V-6, aluminum block and heads, port fuel injection".

aspiration.note: Inferred: the panel's engine line names no turbocharger or supercharger.

fuel.note: Inferred from the panel's engine line.

drivetrain.note: Infiniti's table gives the 2007-2008 sedan as rear-wheel drive with optional AWD; the AWD car was sold as its own model, the G35x, and is not covered here. (Infiniti's table is summarised here, not quoted.)

transmission.note: Infiniti USA's table for the 2007-2008 sedan: "5-speed automatic / 6-speed manual". Panel: "TRANSMISSION 6-speed manual" (source cd-infiniti-g35-2007).

powerHp.note: Car and Driver road-test panel, 2007 G35 with the 6-speed manual. Quote: "Power: 306 hp @ 6800 rpm". Infiniti USA's table gives "306 hp" for the G35 Sedan (2007-2008) (source infiniti-usa-g35), so the rating held for both years.

weightLb.note: Car and Driver road-test curb weight, 2007 G35 sedan with the 6-speed manual (the standard car). Quote: "Curb Weight: 3583 lb". The test car carried the Premium package ("sunroof, 10-speaker sound system, and heated from seats", as the panel prints it), so a car without it is slightly lighter. Infiniti USA's page gives only an approximate range ("~3,500–3,600 lbs"), not used.
